auth.summary: Google Books API uses OAuth 2.0. Two flows are defined: implicit (scheme `Oauth2`) and authorization code (scheme `Oauth2c`). Global security is empty, so auth is optional at the API level; individual operations may still require it.

setupSteps.title: Obtain OAuth 2.0 client credentials
setupSteps.detail: Acquire a client_id and client_secret for your application from Google. Refer to the getting started guide at https://code.google.com/apis/books/docs/v1/getting_started.html for guidance on registering an application.

setupSteps.title: Note the required endpoints and scope
setupSteps.detail: Authorization URL: https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth — Token URL: https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/token — Scope: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/books (Manage your books)

setupSteps.title: Configure the credential in the registry credentials area
setupSteps.detail: Create a credential of type oauth2_authcode with: authorization_url=https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth, token_url=https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/token, scope=https://www.googleapis.com/auth/books, client_id=<your client_id>, client_secret=<your client_secret>. The gateway will perform the authorization code flow at call time and inject the access token as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
